summary_en: 120,000 shares (4.15% of shares outstanding ex-treasury) to be acquired for up to ¥240.0M. Upper price ceiling not disclosed. Execution window: 2026-07-15 to 2026-07-15 (single-day window). Method: ToSTNeT-3 (assumed from single-day execution). Stated rationale: enhance returns to shareholders and capital efficiency while enabling flexible capital policy.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 14 July 2026, the board of Fuji Seiko (6142) resolved to authorize acquisition of up to 120,000 treasury shares (4.15% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a total yen amount not to exceed ¥240 million. The ex-treasury share count as of 30 June 2026 was 2,893,329. The acquisition window is set for a single day: 15 July 2026. No maximum price per share is disclosed in the filing. The stated rationale is to enhance shareholder returns, improve capital efficiency, and execute flexible capital policy responsive to changing business conditions. The acquisition will be executed via ToSTNeT-3 (open-market mechanism for listed companies).
